title: Rees on Wiregrass | Watercolor Vacation Rental | Dune Vacation Rentals – Dune Vacation Rentals
meta_description: A modern, coastal home located in WaterColor; Rees on Wiregrass is a five-bedroom home perfect for your next vacation. Click here to learn more!
description_expanded:
Rees on Wiregrass | WaterColor

144 Wiregrass Way, Santa Rosa Beach, FL 32459

Amenity wristbands for 14 people max.
WaterColor Amenity wristbands are given based on actual guest count with a maximum number of 14. *Home sleeps 14 guests who are over 5 and 4 guests who are 4 years old or younger.* Additional wristbands, over the maximum, are not available. Wristbands provide full access to WaterColor Resort Amenities including the Beach Club, Camp WaterColor, and neighborhood pools. Children under 5 years of age do not require an amenity band. Please ensure accurate guest count is relayed when booking.

‘Rees on Wiregrass’ your modern, coastal dream home in beautiful WaterColor. This 5 bed/8 bath home features a private pool, carriage house and a golf cart that is established in the Lake District of WaterColor. This home is a short walk to the Sand Hill Pool or Boathouse.

Built by Borges Brooks Builders, this home is impeccably designed by Katie Grace Designs with stunning attention to detail that can be found throughout this open-concept property. “Rees on Wiregrass” is perfect for those with large families wanting to enjoy a beach vacation they are sure to never forget. Entering the home, immediately the light and bright decor furnishing the living room and keeping room will grab your attention. Relax on the couch for an intimate fire in the gas fireplace or watch your favorite movie with your loved ones. The gourmet kitchen features stainless steel appliances, a beverage and wine bar, a large island with seating for 7, and a beautiful dining table that offers seating for 12 guests. Just off the kitchen and living room, the entire back portion of the home features beautiful windows for unobstructed views of the porch and pool. The outdoor space of this home features a luxury kitchen and gas grill with a lounge space for the whole family to enjoy being together. The entire property has Sonos Wireless Surround Sound capability, so you never have to pause your favorite song. On those rare rainy days, the media room is the perfect retreat with a full surround sound system to enjoy a good movie while curled up on the comfortable sectional couch. Throughout the home you will find beautifully and warmly decorated king guest bedrooms, each with their own bathrooms for the ultimate relaxation. The cozy bunk room on the third floor includes sleeping arrangements for up to 12 guests, and includes two bathrooms each featuring a tiled shower.

‘Rees on Wiregrass’ is the luxury vacation home you have always dreamt of!

~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~

Home Highlights

Sleeps 14 people age 5 and up and 4 children under age 5

Amenity passes for 14 people max . (we cannot get any extras) which provide Full access to all WaterColor community swimming pools. Children under 5 years of age do not require an amenity pass

5 Bedrooms + Bunk Room

8 Bathrooms

5,578 Square Feet

Private Pool and Spa (can be heated for $65/day)

Carriage House

Gourmet Kitchen

Sonos Wireless - Surround Sound

Spacious Outdoor Living Space

2 Laundry Rooms

6 - Seater Golf Cart

Parking for 5 Vehicles + Garage Access

6 Beach Cruiser Bicycles

*Mid-Stay Partial cleaning is required for stays of 5 to 13 nights.

*Mid-Stay Full cleaning is required for stays of 14 + nights

Complimentary Trolley Rides via WaterColor Trolley App

First Floor

- Beautifully designed beach coastal decor and luxury furnishings

- High-end kitchen featuring stainless steel appliances including two dishwashers, 60’’ Wolf range, 60’’ Sub Zero refrigerator and freezer, pellet ice maker, and ample storage space

- Wet Bar with a built in beverage and wine refrigerator

- Dining table with seating for 12 guests and barstool seating at the kitchen island for 7 guests

- King master bedroom with a 43’’ smart tv and ensuite featuring a double vanity, shower, and soaking tub

- Sand room and laundry room with plentiful beach towel storage

- Media room complete with full surround sound system

- Nano doors in the living room are not available for guest usage. Please do not use, open, unlock, or tamper with the accordion doors. Additional fees may apply if damage or use of doors is found.

Second Floor

- Second king master bedroom with a 65’’ smart tv, seating nook, and ensuite featuring a double vanity and shower

- Additional laundry room with two stackable washers and dryers

- Guest king bedroom with a 65’’ smart tv and ensuite

- Guest king bedroom with a 55’’ smart tv and ensuite

- Private, front balcony featuring a cozy daybed swing and bar table with seating for four

- Expansive balcony complete with a 75’’ smart tv, large sectional couch, and a daybed

- Exterior access to the pool area and the carriage house

Third Floor

- Bunk room complete with four full beds and four twin beds + a trundle bed

- Open lounge space complete with a 75’’ smart tv, full surround sound and a large, cozy couch

- Two bathrooms for bunk room guest to share

- Makeup counter with personal storage cubbies and an additional walk-in closet

Carriage House

- Modern kitchen and furnishings

- Living room features a 65’’ smart tv

- King bedroom with a 43’’ smart tv and ensuite bathroom

- Direct access to the pool or main house via the balcony

Outdoor Space

- Private pool and spa with 4 water chaise loungers on the pool shelf

- Outdoor shower and bathroom

- Outdoor living space complete with a living quarter, 82’’ smart tv, outdoor fireplace, and recliner chairs

- Sonos Wireless Surround Sound throughout the interior and exterior of the property

- Gas grill with a full outdoor kitchen

- Spacious driveway parking and garage access

- 6 Beach cruiser bicycles

Additional

- Nano doors in the living room are not available for guest usage. Please do not use, open, unlock, or tamper with the accordion doors. Additional fees may apply if damage or use of doors is found.

- Elevator is not for guest use.

- Guests can enjoy complimentary rides anywhere in WaterColor using the on-demand WaterColor Trolley, available through the WaterColor Trolley app in your app store.

- Parking for 5 Vehicles.

- No events, such as wedding receptions and other large gatherings are allowed. Only people sleeping in the home are allowed on this property. If violated, double cleaning fees, as well as other possible fees, will apply.

- No pet home. Per the signed Rental Agreement, any violation of the no pet policy will result in immediate eviction, plus additional cleaning charges.

- WaterColor HOA allows one golf cart per address- you may not rent a second cart if the home you have rented offers one. All golf cart rentals in Watercolor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to a specific amount throughout the community at any given time. Cart rentals are granted on a first-come, first-served based. Watercolor condos cannot rent golf carts.

- This home has a video/audio capturing doorbell mounted by the door and/or exterior cameras for safety.

- The HOA issues one parking pass per reservation. Guests are encouraged to park their vehicles in the driveway or garage of their rental home. They do not need a parking pass when their vehicle is parked on a private residential property.The HOA-issued parking pass is required to park a vehicle overnight on the common area parking pads.

Pool/Spa: This home may have a private pool and/or spa. Seasonal pool/spa heating is available upon request for $65/day plus tax. These cannot be heated separately as the water flows from the spa into the pool. If one is heated, they are both heated. Maximum temp for Pool is 90 degrees. Maximum temp for spa is 100 degrees. Pool and/or spa heat is not available during the warmer months from Memorial Day to September 30th.

Reservation/Booking Policy

- Minimum Age: All properties require a minimum of one adult over the age of 26 be staying at the property throughout the rental term.

- A 50% deposit is due at the time of booking.

- Except for a $250 cancelation fee, deposits are fully refundable if cancelations are given 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Balance of payment is due 60 days prior to the arrival date.

- Check-in begins at 4:00 PM and check-out is by 10:00 AM

- Cleaning: Reservations made for more than 12 nights require a full clean during your stay. This will be added onto your total when checking out. Reservations for less than 12 days, have the option to add a mid-stay clean onto your reservation.
